answer: Bind subsidized agent access to verified business registrations. Require proof of authority over an active company number, and pool all its agent keys under one quota indexed by registry and number. An ivory restoration firm, an oasis tour operator or a lantern maker cannot multiply allowances by creating logins. A farmer needs additional legal entities and must pay incorporation, compliance and verification costs. Set each allowance below those recurring costs, and recheck active status before renewal. This depends on reliable registries and fraud checks.
